title: 2. MIN of every parameter
rule: Every knob at its lower bound: R_in 10 mm, PCM fraction 2 %, flow 0.010 kg/s, loosest packing (single-layer).  N = 380 tiny capsules but only ~2 % of the tank volume (1.4 kg of PCM).
why_not_optimal: Almost no PCM (1.4 kg, 2 % of the tank), so almost no latent storage: the gain (2.2 kWh/yr) is ~1 % of the optimum and far inside the repeatability band - indistinguishable from plain water.
